name: motion-impact-squash
title: Impact Squash
description: Quả bóng rơi xuống, giãn dài khi rơi, bẹp ra 155 / 55 % đúng lúc chạm đất rồi bật về tròn.

moworks.author: takayu

options.fall: share of the length falling (0.65, power1.in)
options.squash: [scaleX, scaleY] at contact ([1.55, 0.55]), then back.out to 1
options.tick: [length, thickness] px of the impact ticks ([60, 10])
options.reach: [from, to] px out from the centre ([170, 240])
options.shadow: floor shadow (grows and darkens with the fall)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio impact-squash, written here): Ball (r 20, origin bottom) drops 90 px (demo 99) in 403 ms power1.in, stretching to scaleY 1.1 / scaleX 1/1.1 by contact; on contact it is 1.55 / 0.55 at once and recovers to 1/1 by 620 ms through back.out (217 ms, slightly past 1). Two pairs of impact ticks flick out at the sides over 250 ms; the floor shadow grows and darkens with the fall. Params: duration (0.62 s) · drop: độ cao rơi (90 px) · squash (1.55 / 0.55) · recover (0.22 s).
moworks.titleVi: Rơi xuống bẹp ra khi chạm đất
